user.title: Connect your CatGenie
user.description: Choose how to sign in to your CatGenie account.

menu_options.token: I already have a refresh token

phone.title: Phone number
phone.description: Enter the phone number you use to sign in to the CatGenie app. A login code will be sent by SMS.

data_description.country_code: Digits only, without the plus sign. 1 for the US and Canada.
data_description.phone: Your number without the country code.

verify.title: Enter the SMS code
verify.description: A code was sent to {phone}. Enter it below. Codes expire after a few minutes.

token.title: Refresh token
token.description: Paste a CatGenie refresh token. Treat it like a password.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your CatGenie login has expired or was revoked. Continue to receive a new SMS code.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the CatGenie cloud. Try again in a minute.
error.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. It may have expired; go back and request a new one.
error.invalid_token: That refresh token was not accepted.

abort.already_configured: This CatGenie account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in to a different CatGenie account than the one being re-authenticated.

auth_failed.message: The CatGenie cloud rejected the saved login. Re-authenticate the integration.

update_failed.message: Could not get an update from the CatGenie cloud: {error}

command_failed.message: The CatGenie cloud did not accept the command: {error}
